items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I would do little solos and then Jeeter and I would do, I used to put his clarinet in this end of my mouth and my trombone hand he would finger it

ctx.x: YOU WERE STRICKLY, THIS WAS STRICKLY WITH A SAXOPHONE MOUTHPIECE. WERE YOU PLAYING WHOLE ARRANGEMENTS WITH THE BAND OR DID YOU KEEP ON DOING REGULAR PIECES.
I would do little solos and then Jeeter and I would do, I used to put his clarinet in this end of my mouth and my trombone hand he would finger it and then that would be that.
